text: Keys are secured with MPC or passkeys; APIs create wallets, sign transactions and authorize actions without you handling raw private keys
quote: You don't manage raw private keys. Circle secures keys with MPC or passkeys depending on wallet product; you get APIs to create wallets, sign transactions, and authorize actions.

text: Developers can sponsor network fees under policies they set and pay for gas by credit card, so users don't need to hold native tokens
quote: Sponsor network fees so your users don't need to hold native tokens. Set policies and pay gas with your credit card.

text: Users can pay gas fees in USDC through Circle's permissionless ERC-4337 paymaster contracts
quote: Let users pay gas fees with USDC instead of native tokens using Circle's permissionless ERC-4337 paymaster contracts.

text: CCTP moves USDC across chains by burn-and-mint, extends to EURC and registered third-party assets, and needs no bridge liquidity pools
quote: CCTP natively transfers USDC across blockchains using burn-and-mint, and extends to EURC and registered third-party assets through CCTP for non-USDC, all without traditional bridge liquidity pools.

text: Automated actions can be triggered on the destination chain after cross-chain assets arrive
quote: Trigger automated actions on the destination blockchain after assets arrive

text: Agent Wallets let AI agents hold and spend USDC and other tokens with customizable spending controls and compliance guardrails
quote: Use Agent wallets to hold and spend USDC and other tokens with customizable spending controls and built-in compliance guardrails.

text: Agents can search x402-compatible APIs and pay per request without subscriptions or API keys
quote: Search x402-compatible APIs and pay per request, without subscriptions or API keys.

text: A single public endpoint discovers x402 services that accept USDC across many chains, with no API key or account needed
quote: One public endpoint to discover x402 services that accept USDC, across many blockchains. No API key, no account.

text: One command interface handles wallets, transfers, swaps, bridging, contract calls and paying for services
quote: Create and manage wallets, transfer, swap, and bridge USDC across blockchains, execute smart contracts, and discover or pay for services. All through a single command interface, without integrating multiple APIs and SDKs.

text: Circle's MCP server lets an LLM or AI IDE generate and fix code that uses Wallets, Contracts, CCTP and Gateway
quote: Integrate Circle's MCP server to let your LLM or AI-assisted IDE generate and fix code for crypto apps using Circle's offerings, including Wallets, Contracts, CCTP, and Gateway.

text: When a resource changes state, Circle sends an HTTP POST webhook to an endpoint you configure
quote: When a resource changes state, Circle sends an HTTP POST to the endpoint you configure so your application can react.

text: Payment network notifications are signed, and you verify them with a public key fetched from an API endpoint
quote: Verify each notification's signature before you trust it. Fetch the public key with `GET /v2/cpn/notifications/publicKey/{id}`.

text: Webhook subscriptions can be managed for Gateway event notifications
quote: Manage webhook subscriptions for Gateway event notifications.

text: Self-managed mode leaves custody, payouts and compliance to you; managed mode has Circle handle licensing, custody, compliance and settlement
quote: Self-managed: You operate your own stablecoin lifecycle, including custody, payouts, and compliance... Managed: Circle handles licensing, custody, compliance, treasury, and settlement on your behalf.

text: Cross-border fiat payouts go through payout partners, using real-time FX quotes, onchain USDC settlement and local fiat delivery to the receiver
quote: Send cross-border fiat payouts through a network of payout partners. Request real-time FX quotes, settle in USDC onchain, and let partners deliver local fiat to the receiver.

text: Qualified businesses can use a Circle Mint account to convert USD to and from USDC at no additional cost
quote: Qualified businesses can apply for a Circle Mint account to readily convert USD to and from USDC at no additional cost.

text: Integration is available through REST APIs and Web, Android and iOS SDKs
quote: You integrate using REST APIs or Web and Mobile SDKs (Android and iOS).

text: Bridge Kit is a lightweight SDK, built on CCTP, for transferring USDC between chains in a few lines of code
quote: Bridge Kit is a lightweight SDK that uses CCTP as its protocol provider, letting you transfer USDC between blockchains in just a few lines of code.

text: Agent Nanopayments let AI agents pay for x402-compatible services in sub-cent USDC amounts
quote: Agent Nanopayments, built on Gateway Nanopayments, let your AI agent pay for x402-compatible services in sub-cent USDC.

text: Your own API can charge AI agents per request in USDC over x402 by returning 402 Payment Required until a valid payment is attached
quote: Make your API charge AI agents per request in USDC over x402: your endpoint returns 402 Payment Required when a request is unpaid, and serves the resource when a valid payment is attached.

text: Services can be listed in an Agent Marketplace so agents can discover and pay for them
quote: List your service in the Agent Marketplace so agents can discover and pay for it.

text: Idempotency keys let you retry API calls safely without creating duplicate operations
quote: Use idempotency keys to safely retry API calls without creating duplicate operations

text: A screening request can be created to check a specific blockchain address on a specific chain
quote: Create a screening request for a specific blockchain address and chain.

text: USDC is backed 100% by liquid cash and cash-equivalent assets and is redeemable 1:1 for USD
quote: USDC is backed 100% by highly liquid cash and cash-equivalent assets so that it's always redeemable 1:1 for USD.

text: EURC is backed 100% by euro-denominated reserves and is redeemable 1:1 for EUR
quote: EURC is backed 100% by euro-denominated reserves so that it's always redeemable 1:1 for EUR.

text: Circle Gateway creates a chain-abstracted USDC, EURC or cirBTC balance that can be transferred instantly to any supported chain
quote: Circle Gateway allows you to create a chain-abstracted USDC, EURC, or cirBTC balance and transfer it instantly to any supported destination chain.

text: Circle agent skills install into Claude Code as a plugin or through the Vercel Skills CLI
quote: In Claude Code: run /plugin marketplace add circlefin/skills then /plugin install circle-skills@circle.

text: A USDC skill covers balances, transfers and approvals on EVM chains and Solana
quote: use-usdc ... (balances, transfers, approvals on EVM and Solana)

text: User-controlled embedded wallets support Web2-style login
quote: use-user-controlled-wallets ... (embedded wallets with Web2 login)

text: Developer-controlled custodial wallets are offered for payouts and treasury
quote: use-developer-controlled-wallets ... (custodial wallets for payouts and treasury)

text: An API creates a user initialization challenge and provisions one or more wallets, organized into retrievable wallet sets
quote: Creates a challenge for user initialization and creates one or more wallets.

text: A skill covers Arc chain configuration, contract deployment and USDC bridging
quote: use-arc ... (Arc chain config, contract deployment, USDC bridging

text: The full documentation index is published at llms.txt for agents
quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](/llms.txt)

text: Endpoints batch-process EIP-3009 authorizations
quote: Endpoints for batch processing of EIP-3009 authorizations

text: The fee for deploying a contract from a template can be estimated in advance
quote: Estimate the fee required to deploy contract by template.

text: Trade quotes between two currencies come as executable (tradable) or indicative (reference) quotes
quote: Creates a quote for a trade between two currencies. ... Use `type:tradable` for an executable quote or `type:reference` for an indica

text: Settlement advances can be requested, tracked and repaid through the API
quote: Request, track, and repay settlement advances.

text: An endpoint returns the supported countries, currencies, payment methods and blockchains
quote: Returns the overview of supported countries, currencies, payment methods, blockchains.

text: An API retrieves the signed attestation for a USDC burn event on the source chain
quote: Retrieves the signed attestation for a USDC burn event on the source chain.

text: CCTP APIs let you query Fast Transfer allowances and fees and start a re-attestation
quote: querying Fast Transfer allowances and fees, and initiating re-attestation processes.

text: xReserve transfers between USDC and USDC-backed tokens across supported networks using an attestation system
quote: xReserve enables transfers between USDC and USDC-backed tokens across supported blockchain networks using a secure attestation system.
